scope: Proposition 4.4 of the manuscript “Frobenius Structures on Tame Hecke Eigensheaves” (preprints/Frobenius-Structures-on-Tame-Hecke-Eigensheaves-October-5-2026/tame-hecke-frobenius.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 014 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b0540eb39aad89c2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exists a continuous Zariski-dense parameter τ : πet 1 (C) −→ J ⊂ PGLn(L′ ) with equivariance under φ. For every algebraic representation of PGLn, an invariant lattice in its evaluation local system has finite reductions extending lisse over V ×Sb∗ Sbr for sufficiently large r. These extensions are equivariant and specialize on the two punctured components to σ1 and σ2, with their given actions, compatibly with the entire tensor system.
